rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Senate plenary approved Opinion No. 475/2016 of the Special Impeachment Committee, which concluded for admitting Denúncia No. 1/2016 and the consequent institution of the impeachment process against President Dilma Rousseff: yes 55, no 22 (President 1, total 78). The electronic vote ran from 06:30:42 to 06:33:26 on 12 May 2016 in the 71st extraordinary deliberative session opened on 11 May 2016 at 10:00; the session rose at 06:38 on 12 May.

locator.printed_pages: 167 (proclamation 'SIM, 55; NÃO, 22'), 168 (closing time), 169-171 (vote list header and totals)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the vote the President of the Senate read the Mandado de Intimação: from the President's receipt of it the impeachment process is instituted and she is suspended from the functions of President under art. 86, §1, II of the Constitution until the Senate's judgment or the 180-day limit, keeping residence, security, health care, transport, pay and personal staff. He announced that the First Secretary (Senator Vicentinho Alves) would serve it during the morning of Thursday 12 May and then notify the Vice-President.

locator.passage: 'Comunico, ainda, que a Senhora Presidente da República será intimada' through the end of the mandado text
